verdict.rationale: Lithic documents dated API versioning: clients pin a version via the `api-version` request header and control when changes reach their integration (lithic-docs-7, lithic-docs-28). There is no evidence of a documented deprecation policy with timelines or sunset rules; the only related item is a single migration guide from legacy webhooks to the Events API (lithic-docs-23). missing for 10: documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, supported-version windows), changelog of versions, independent corroboration.
